subject: Recap & Mutual Action Plan — Helios Therapeutics discovery
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostx.com>, Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@heliostx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & Mutual Action Plan — Helios Therapeutics discovery

Laura / Mike — thanks again for taking time today. Quick written recap from our 45m discovery so we have alignment and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please reply with any adjustments.

Key pain points you described
- Model latency spikes for batch inference during overnight reporting windows (esp. long-sequence prompts).
- Cost unpredictability when teams scale batched embed/rr tasks across multiple pipelines.
- Lack of single-pane observability across cloud regions and on-prem test infra.

Goals you shared
- Stable 95th percentile latency under 250ms for interactive scoring (regional traffic).
- 30–40% reduction in token/unit spend on nightly batch workloads via smarter batching and caching.
- A compliance-ready private deployment option for PHI workloads (VPC + KMS integration).

Decision process & stakeholders (as described on call)
- Technical eval: Laura (ML Platform) + Mike (SRE) — PoC run and performance validation (2–3 weeks).
- Procurement: finance + legal (start after PoC), target contract approval in Q2.
- Executive sign-off: VP of Engineering (final price/SLA).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft)
1) Week 0 (this week) — Align scope + get access
   - Deliverables: PoC requirements doc, initial data sample, access request for test environment.
   - Owners: Jonas (Redwood) / Laura (Helios).
   - Target date: 2026-04-02

2) Week 1–2 — PoC setup & baseline run
   - Deliverables: Hosted test endpoint, baseline metrics (latency/cost), config suggestions (batching/quantization).
   - Owners: Marissa (Redwood Deploy) / Mike (Helios SRE).
   - Target date: 2026-04-16

3) Week 3 — Optimization & regression checks
   - Deliverables: Optimized runtime config, KV/prefix cache verification, regression eval on prompt suite.
   - Owners: Redwood infra + Helios ML team
   - Target date: 2026-04-23

4) Week 4 — Exec review & procurement kickoff
   - Deliverables: PoC report, proposed pricing for Dedicated capacity or Private deployment, SLA draft.
   - Owners: Jonas + Marissa (Redwood), Laura + Finance (Helios)
   - Target date: 2026-04-30

Immediate next steps (today)
- I will send the PoC template and a short access checklist (attaching draft).
- Laura: can you share a 1 GB sample of the reporting prompts (sanitized) and confirm a test VPC & contact for SRE access?
- Mike: confirm whether the SSO/SCIM provider is Okta or Azure AD and whether we should include a temporary service account.

Attachments: Redwood-Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx (draft milestones), Helios-RFI-notes.pdf (call notes)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the HubSpot deal link and calendar invites for the PoC kickoff once I have confirmation on the sample and SRE contact.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@heliostx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & Mutual Action Plan — Helios Therapeutics discovery

Thanks Jonas — this looks great and captures the conversation well. A few clarifications:
- We can provide a sanitized 1 GB prompt sample by 2026-04-01.
- SRE contact for the test environment: mike.oconnor@heliostx.com (I looped him in). We use Okta for SSO.
- Procurement timeline: we’re pushing to have commercial terms in place by end of April but legal will likely require a 2-week review after PoC.

Small change to MAP: shift PoC baseline completion from 2026-04-16 to 2026-04-18 (our holidays next week). Otherwise good to proceed.

Laura Chen
Director, ML Platform | Helios Therapeutics
laura.chen@heliostx.com | +1 (617) 555-2201

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostx.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & Mutual Action Plan — Helios Therapeutics discovery

Quick internal note for transparency on pricing options for the PoC:
- Option A (Hosted evaluation): minimal setup, metered usage; expected to show cost delta but not full Private behavior.
- Option B (Dedicated short-term): reserved capacity for the PoC window — better 95th pctl stability, higher upfront but clearer cost estimates.
- Option C (Private/VPC eval): customer-managed networking, needs legal & infra sign-off; best for PHI compliance.

Jonas — if Helios is leaning toward dedicated for performance parity with their production, I’ll prepare a short quote and include a 30-day trial credit that we can apply to the PoC.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Redwood-Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx
From: Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@heliostx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostx.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & Mutual Action Plan — Helios Therapeutics discovery

All good here — we accept the MAP with the small date change to baseline completion (2026-04-18).
Two quick asks before kickoff:
1) Can you send an architecture diagram for the Dedicated vs Private options highlighting network flow and KMS integration?
2) We need a short statement on data residency and retention for the PoC (HIPAA/PHI considerations) so our compliance team can triage.

If you can deliver those by 2026-04-06 we’ll block time for a joint kickoff the week of 2026-04-13.

Thanks,
Mike O'Connor
Senior SRE | Helios Therapeutics
Attachment requested: architecture-diagram-placeholder.png
